tasks.title: Add PDF parser for Mercado Pago credit-card faturas
tasks.justification: The Mercado Pago credit-card account has no working import path: its Google Drive folder had no .account file, and even with one there's no parser for its PDF fatura format. Design and implementation plan confirmed with the user (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-08-mercadopago-cartao-pdf-parser-design.md, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-mercadopago-cartao-pdf-parser.md). Key finding during plan-writing: verified against the real pdftotext -layout output that the fatura's decoy 'Total da fatura de <mês anterior>' line would collide with the existing Bradesco-oriented total regex, so the plan isolates a new Mercado-Pago-specific total extraction path instead of widening the shared one. Now executing via subagent-driven-development.
